summary.en: A promptable segmentation model and billion-mask dataset
summary.zh: 可提示分割模型与十亿级掩码数据集

description.en:
Segment Anything reframed image segmentation as a promptable task: a user or downstream system supplies points, boxes or masks, and one model returns valid object masks. Its architecture separates a reusable image encoder from lightweight prompt and mask decoders so one image embedding can support interactive responses.

The project also introduced SA-1B, a dataset of more than one billion masks collected from about eleven million licensed and privacy-respecting images through a model-assisted data engine.
description.zh:
Segment Anything 把图像分割重构为可提示任务：用户或下游系统提供点、框或掩码，一个模型返回有效对象掩码。其架构把可复用图像编码器与轻量提示编码器、掩码解码器分开，使同一图像嵌入能够支持交互式响应。

项目还推出 SA-1B 数据集，通过模型辅助数据引擎，从约 1100 万张经过许可并注重隐私的图像中收集超过 10 亿个掩码。

html.en: Segmentation models were usually trained for a fixed label set or narrow task, so adapting them required new annotations and retraining. Segment Anything pursued a foundation-model approach in which prompts define the object of interest at inference time.
html.zh: 分割模型通常针对固定标签集合或狭窄任务训练，适配新任务需要重新标注与训练。Segment Anything 采用基础模型思路，让提示在推理时定义感兴趣对象。

html.en: A large image encoder computes an embedding once, while separate prompt and mask decoders respond quickly to points, boxes or mask inputs. Ambiguity-aware output and a model-assisted data engine make it possible to support interactive use and grow a very large segmentation dataset.
html.zh: 大型图像编码器只计算一次嵌入，独立的提示编码器与掩码解码器则快速响应点、框或掩码输入。对歧义的多掩码输出和模型辅助数据引擎，使交互使用与超大规模分割数据集建设成为可能。

html.en: Experts generally treat Segment Anything as a foundation-model moment for image segmentation because one promptable interface transfers across many object types and downstream tasks. Its model and data release became common infrastructure for annotation, editing, tracking, medical imaging experiments and multimodal systems.
html.zh: 专家通常把 Segment Anything 视为图像分割进入基础模型阶段的标志，因为一个可提示接口可以迁移到多种对象与下游任务。其模型与数据发布成为标注、编辑、跟踪、医学影像实验和多模态系统的常用基础设施。
